title: Rollers division
description: A denim-blue band for a sub-brand: a charcoal chip, a very large white heading with a navy second line and two stacked buttons (white pill, orange rectangle) on the right; then a row ruled in soft white with a wide 2:1 photo and a paragraph beside it, and a ruled row of three features. Lines draw in, words rise, text fades up.
notes: colours: bg-accent with accent-foreground text and text-highlight for the second line; pick a theme whose accent is a strong colour
the original's large ring artwork in the band's background is left out (brand art)
media is a placeholder until you pass an with object-cover and full size
